scripts.text:
INSERT INTO gold.dim_diagnostico
    (codigo_icd, descripcion_patologia, nivel_severidad)
SELECT
    'SIN_REGISTRO', N'Sin diagnóstico registrado', 'No informado'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM gold.dim_diagnostico
    WHERE codigo_icd = 'SIN_REGISTRO'
);

scriptLines:
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    TRIM(department) AS nombre_departamento
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(department), '') IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    TRIM(icd_code) AS codigo_icd,
    NULLIF(TRIM(diagnosis_description), '') AS descripcion_patologia,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(severity), ''), 'No informado') AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.diagnoses
WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code), '') IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT admission_date AS fecha_completa
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT discharge_date AS fecha_completa
FROM silver.admissions
WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
UNION
SELECT payment_date AS fecha_completa
FROM silver.billing
WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL',

query: 'SELECT
    p.patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    p.full_name AS nombre_completo,
    CASE UPPER(TRIM(p.gender))
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'Femenino'
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'Masculino'
        ELSE 'Otro'
    END AS genero,
    p.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN p.date_of_birth IS NULL OR p.date_of_birth > corte.hoy THEN NULL
        WHEN edad.anios <= 18 THEN '0-18'
        WHEN edad.anios <= 35 THEN '19-35'
        WHEN edad.anios <= 60 THEN '36-60'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS rango_etario,
    p.email AS correo_electronico,
    p.address AS direccion,
COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.insurance_provider), ''), N'No informado') AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients AS p
CROSS APPLY (VALUES (CAST(SYSUTCDATETIME() AS date))) AS corte(hoy)
CROSS APPLY (VALUES (DATEDIFF(year, p.date_of_birth, corte.hoy))) AS dif(anios)
CROSS APPLY (VALUES (
    dif.anios - CASE
        WHEN DATEADD(year, dif.anios, p.date_of_birth) > corte.hoy THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END
)) AS edad(anios)',

query: 'SELECT DISTINCT
    charge_type AS tipo_cargo,
    payment_status AS estado_pago
FROM silver.billing',

query: 'SELECT
    a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
    a.patient_id,
    TRIM(a.department) AS nombre_departamento,
    a.admission_date AS fecha_ingreso,
    a.discharge_date AS fecha_alta,
    a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
    DATEDIFF(day, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia,
    1 AS conteo_admisiones,
    CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_id IS NULL THEN 'SIN_REGISTRO'
         ELSE TRIM(d.icd_code) END AS codigo_icd,
    CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_id IS NULL THEN N'Sin diagnóstico registrado'
         ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(d.diagnosis_description), '') END AS descripcion_patologia,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(d.severity), ''), 'No informado') AS nivel_severidad
FROM silver.admissions AS a
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
        dx.diagnosis_id,
        dx.icd_code,
        dx.diagnosis_description,
        dx.severity
    FROM silver.diagnoses AS dx
    WHERE dx.admission_id = a.admission_id
    ORDER BY dx.diagnosis_id
) AS d',
isDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),
isDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),
isDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(payment_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),
severity = iif(isNull(severity) || trim(severity) == '', toString(null()), upper(trim(severity)))) ~> LimpiarDiagnosticos
PacientesBronze derive(gender = case(     in(['f', 'female'], lower(trim(gender))), 'F',     in(['m', 'male'], lower(trim(gender))), 'M',     toString(null()) ),

date_of_birth = case(     isNull(date_of_birth), toDate(null()),     length(trim(date_of_birth)) == 8, toDate(null()),     isDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),     isDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),     isDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),     isDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'), toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),     toDate(null()) )) ~> LimpiarPacientes
